Source Serif 4 Variable, by Adobe (original, unmodified web font files).

Roman:
https://adobe-fonts.github.io/source-serif/fonts/VAR/SourceSerif4Variable-Roman.otf.woff2
Italic:
https://adobe-fonts.github.io/source-serif/fonts/VAR/SourceSerif4Variable-Italic.otf.woff2

Upstream: https://github.com/adobe-fonts/source-serif
License: SIL Open Font License 1.1; see source-serif-LICENSE.txt.

The documentation self-hosts these fonts. Its navigation and Planum identity
continue to use Source Sans 3; Source Serif 4 is reserved for reading and headings.
